metadata.description: Wicked Sick team marketplace for Cursor: featured plugins for token attribution and public astronomy data. Import this repository as a Team Marketplace; each plugin is an in-repo path under plugins/.

plugins.name: token-usage
plugins.description: Attribute Cursor token usage to the work that consumed it — per-activity breakdowns, session history, API-price estimates, and an MCP server with optional hook attribution.

plugins.name: publicuniverse
plugins.description: Public Universe astronomy tools and skills: explore catalogue data, plan stargazing, explain objects, build lessons and check space facts using a free public MCP server.
